records: Liqwall's 2026-10-30 19:12 UTC XRP derivatives panel is one provider snapshot; its 14-exchange coverage and contract universe are provider-defined and not automatically comparable with other OI aggregators.
Liqwall's 71.7% Binance long-account share is an account-count measure, not notional position exposure.
Aggregate XRP funding and Binance funding have opposite signs in the same snapshot; preserve venue-level rates rather than flattening to one sentiment score.
Cross-provider XRP open-interest totals remain materially inconsistent because contract coverage and aggregation differ; do not average them.

XRP Insights ETF flows are issuer-reported holdings deltas across six spot funds plus BITW; GXRP is excluded from flow calculations but included in holdings, and XRP-denominated changes are not the same as confirmed dollar subscriptions.
The Oct29 U.S. ETF session closed at 20:00 UTC, before the first identified Binance XRPL drain at approximately 20:05 UTC; Oct29 ETF flows cannot be treated as a response to the incident.
Circle's $71.0B USDC circulation and -$1.0B/-$4.2B/-$5.2B net issuance windows are measured as of Oct26 and predate the Binance incident; they cannot be attributed to the hack.
BEA Q3 2026 GDP/PCE figures are advance estimates subject to revision and provide macro context, not direct evidence of XRP-specific demand.
Fed and BOJ policy observations are macro context; no direct XRP causal flow or carry-trade exposure was measured.

CoinDesk's Binance14 proof-of-reserves finding concerns an Ethereum hot wallet; it does not establish that any of the five Binance-labelled XRPL source wallets appeared in the October1 XRP reserve address set.

Binance's official PoR page describes wallet ownership, snapshot, Merkle and zk-SNARK methodology, but the underlying XRP address export was not exposed in the current web text capture; five-wallet membership remains unresolved.
Binance's approximately $1.34B market/OTC replenishment is an aggregate company statement; no XRP-specific allocation, venue, price, execution or transaction proof is disclosed.

The approximately $3B frozen asset figure is not equivalent to recovered assets and Binance states it is separate from the $6.34B company reserve; token-level composition and final recovery remain unverified.

ICOBench's report that the attacker receiver held 233,461,943 XRP with no outgoing transfer through 14:40 UTC is secondary reporting; no direct explorer refresh after 14:40 UTC was obtained in this run.

The reported 310M XRP Ripple-associated movement is sourced from Whale Alert/ICOBench; exact transaction hashes, destination ownership, purpose, exchange routing and sale status were not independently verified. It is not evidence of a Binance-incident link.

PR #1379's latest hardened head has nine isolated static pytest checks passed locally, but no exact-head remote CI was observed after the security-hardening commits; the earlier 361-test/8-subtest CI applies to its pre-hardening head.
PR #1380's authorization-gate correction passed an isolated local regression reproduction, but exact-head remote CI was not observed and the full repository test suite was not run.
PR #1353's current branch head 89105cf is a metadata successor to the last exact-head validated data commit 9f34c660; the current successor has not been revalidated.

Main's signal_history.jsonl is empty, signal_accuracy.json still shows a legacy 45.9% result from 772/1,683 variable-horizon checks, and latest_signal remains stale at Oct29 13:23 UTC with confidence 0.0; none is a valid current out-of-sample XRP forecast.

Main still contains scheduled cross-analysis and daily signal-accuracy writers, plus a manual Knowledge Signal Cycle path capable of writing generated outputs directly to main; PR #1379 remains unmerged.
Issue #1377 remains open after two autonomous task attempts failed closed; PR #1380 is not merged and the task was not rerun.
Only GitHub access has verified evidence; Claude, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Codex, Hugging Face, Kaggle and Databricks have not been authenticated or tested as live collaborators.
Full repository CI, dependency vulnerability scanning and runtime dispatch of the hardened Knowledge Signal Cycle were not performed.
